<issue>
Infinite recursion in OPC package relationship traversal

#### Description

When iterating through OPC package relationships, the code enters an infinite recursion loop causing stack overflow errors. This affects operations that traverse document structure like `iter_inner_content()` and package image part gathering.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document

# This will cause infinite recursion
document = Document('some_document.docx')
list(document.iter_inner_content())
```

The issue also manifests when accessing image parts:

```python
from docx.opc.package import Package

package = Package.open('document_with_images.docx')
image_parts = package.image_parts  # Infinite recursion occurs here
```

#### Expected Behavior

The relationship traversal should complete without infinite loops and return the expected content/parts.

#### Actual Behavior

The code enters an infinite recursion loop during relationship traversal, eventually causing a stack overflow.
</issue>
